Bihar Bus Accident : uttar pradesh ki rajdhani lakhnaoo men divali ke dusre din aagra-lakhnaoo eksapres-ve par bhishan sarak hadsa ho gaya. mohan rod sthit jiro pvaint ke pas yatriyon se bhari ek bas aniyantrit hokar eksapres-ve se niche palat gaee. hadse ke bad mauke par chikh-pukar mach gaee. shuruaati jankari ke mutabik, bas men karib 60 yatri savar the. durghatna men lagbhag 45 yatriyon ke ghayal hone ki suchna hai.
